groups.title: [single observable behavior]
groups.validationBoundary: [public seam plus one executable validation command or assertion]

uiRequiredExample.when: the group implements a UI_CONTEXT page or interaction; copy real IDs and route from UI_CONTEXT.json
uiRequiredExample.title: [single observable UI behavior]
uiRequiredExample.validationBoundary: one executable UI test validates the referenced page behavior against its required visual source

matrixExceptionExample.when: one group covers 6-12 scenarios that share one request/response or state-matrix validation loop
matrixExceptionExample.title: [shared observable matrix behavior]
matrixExceptionExample.validationBoundary: one request returns the complete matrix and one executable assertion validates it
matrixExceptionExample.splitRationale: SCN-001, SCN-003, and SCN-006 share the same request, response assertion, and validation loop, so they cannot be validated independently.

externalDependencyExample.when: the observable outcome is owned and executable only in a repository or system outside this Feature
externalDependencyExample.title: [record externally owned outcome]
externalDependencyExample.validationBoundary: record the external owner and tracking reference without creating local implementation or tests
